stories.title: Em 2 cidades, Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula tiveram o exato mesmo número de votos para presidente no 1º turno

en.title: In 2 cities, Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula received exactly the same number of votes for president in the first round
en.summary: Brazil's 2026 presidential first round ended with the narrowest margin in history, with Flávio Bolsonaro receiving 47.03% and Lula 45.16%, a difference of 1.87 percentage points. Two municipalities recorded identical vote totals for both candidates.

stories.title: Lula perde terreno nas cidades pequenas, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro avança no interior

en.title: Lula loses ground in small cities, while Flávio Bolsonaro advances in the interior
en.summary: Analysis of the 2026 presidential election's first round shows Lula lost support in small municipalities compared to 2022, while Flávio Bolsonaro gained ground in interior regions. The shift concentrated in cities with up to 10,000 inhabitants.

stories.title: Incêndio atinge prédio da Universidade Federal de Pernambuco

en.title: Fire breaks out at Federal University of Pernambuco building
en.summary: A fire occurred at a building on the Federal University of Pernambuco campus in Recife on Wednesday evening. No information about injuries was immediately available.

stories.title: São Paulo repete erros, perde para o Cruzeiro e não mostra perspectiva de melhora no Brasileirão

en.title: São Paulo repeats mistakes, loses to Cruzeiro and shows no sign of improvement in the Brasileirão
en.summary: São Paulo suffered a defeat against Cruzeiro in the Brasileirão championship, continuing to display problematic performance patterns without demonstrating signs of tactical or competitive recovery.

stories.title: São Paulo perde no Mineirão, e Cruzeiro salta para o quarto lugar no Brasileiro

en.title: São Paulo loses at Mineirão, and Cruzeiro jumps to fourth place in Brasileiro
en.summary: Cruzeiro defeated São Paulo 2-0 on Wednesday at Mineirão stadium in Belo Horizonte during the 29th round of the Brazilian Championship, with goals from Kaio Jorge and Zé Lucas.

stories.title: Abstenção e voto útil explicam Flávio Bolsonaro na frente de Lula no 1º turno, dizem especialistas

en.title: Abstention and tactical voting explain Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in first round, say experts
en.summary: Experts attribute Flávio Bolsonaro's lead over Lula in the first round of presidential elections to abstention and tactical voting patterns among voters.

stories.title: Ala do MDB cobra apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro, mas Baleia Rossi resiste

en.title: MDB wing demands support for Flávio Bolsonaro, but Baleia Rossi resists
en.summary: Members of the MDB from various regions are pressuring party president Baleia Rossi to endorse senator Flávio Bolsonaro, though Rossi is currently resisting the effort.

stories.title: Corinthians demite Fernando Diniz após sétima derrota seguida com time na beira do rebaixamento

en.title: Corinthians fires Fernando Diniz after seventh consecutive loss with team on brink of relegation
en.summary: Corinthians dismissed coach Fernando Diniz following the team's seventh consecutive defeat as the club faces the threat of relegation.

stories.title: Corinthians demite Diniz após derrota para o Inter, a 7ª seguida no Brasileiro

en.title: Corinthians fires Diniz after defeat to Inter, the 7th consecutive loss in the Brazilian Championship
en.summary: Corinthians dismissed manager Diniz following a 2-1 loss to Internacional that extended the team's winless streak to seven consecutive matches in the Brazilian Championship.

stories.title: Críticas de aliados a Janja se intensificam após Lula terminar primeiro turno atrás de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Criticism of Janja intensifies among allies after Lula finishes first round behind Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: President Lula's deficit in the presidential race prompted PT members and allies to express discomfort with first lady Janja's high media exposure during the first round of voting.

stories.title: Republicanos anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno

en.title: Republicans announces support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2nd round
en.summary: The Republican Party declared its support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round of the presidential election.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe apoio de partidos e fala em mudar Constituição

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro receives party support and discusses changing the Constitution
en.summary: PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro secured formal backing from the Progressive Union federation and the Novo party, whose candidate Romeu Zema received 0.27% of first-round votes.

stories.title: Austrália comprará navios de guerra do Japão apesar de cortes orçamentários, diz ministro

en.title: Australia will buy warships from Japan despite budget cuts, minister says
en.summary: Australia's finance minister confirmed the country will increase defense spending and proceed with purchasing warships from Japan despite planned budget cuts for fiscal year 2026, citing efforts to manage debt obligations and labor costs.

stories.title: Ferramentas de IA são identificadas em ataques cibernéticos contra bancos sul-coreanos

en.title: AI tools identified in cyberattacks against South Korean banks
en.summary: Cyberattacks on South Korean banks recently involved artificial intelligence services including Anthropic's Claude Code and a Chinese open-source tool called Artex, raising concerns about AI-enabled threats to financial security.

stories.title: Valdemar admite que houve discussão sobre golpe em 2022, mas nega crime

en.title: Valdemar admits there was discussion of coup in 2022 but denies crime
en.summary: The PL party president acknowledged discussions about a potential coup at the end of Bolsonaro's 2022 presidency but denied criminal wrongdoing, advocating for amnesty for those convicted of January 8, 2023 actions.

stories.title: Petróleo sobe com tensões no Oriente Médio intensificando receios de interrupção no fornecimento

en.title: Oil rises amid Middle East tensions intensifying supply disruption concerns
en.summary: Oil prices increased in Asia as escalating Middle East tensions heightened worries about potential supply interruptions in the region.

stories.title: IBM recebe aval de agência voltada à computação quântica; por que os investidores devem prestar atenção?

en.title: IBM receives approval from quantum computing agency; why should investors pay attention?
en.summary: The U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency selected IBM to advance to the final stage of its Quantum Computing Benchmarking Initiative.
